verdict.rationale: CSV import/export lets users perform bulk product/category changes (swell-docs-14), and the backend API's schema-discovery and generated REST resources (swell-docs-9/22/23) could support scripted bulk operations, but there is no explicit bulk-operations endpoint, batch API, or agent-oriented bulk workflow documented. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API endpoints, rate-limit/throughput guidance for large-scale operations, and any AI-agent example performing bulk actions across many items.
